title: Signal: Composer lockfile without a content hash
scope: A composer.lock file that declares a `composer.lock` that records no usable `content-hash`.
limitations: It matches a `composer.lock` that records no usable `content-hash` in the parsed composer.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A composer.lock that mentions a `composer.lock` that records no usable `content-hash` in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
